title: Base ListIdentity variant 2
purpose: Exercise a conservative boundary-adjacent discovery form by using the minimal zero-length encapsulated request while preserving canonical header layout.
expected_behavior: Parser recognizes a minimal discovery command and safely processes a zero-payload request with a valid 24-byte encapsulation header.
constraints_preserved: Prefer EtherNet/IP encapsulation headers with little-endian payload length
Use a 24-byte encapsulation header when that form is selected

issue_safety_notes: This seed keeps the smallest conservative form for discovery and is intended as a stable mutation base. It relies only on internal prior, not external confirmation.
